assistant|powwow_recommendation: The Gathering of Nations, one of the largest powwows in North America, takes place in Albuquerque, New Mexico
The Denver March Powwow is held each spring at the Colorado State Fairgrounds in Denver, showcasing the history and traditions of the region's indigenous tribes
The Black Hills Powwow, one of the longest-running powwows in South Dakota, is held annually in Rapid City
The Stanford Powwow, held at Stanford University in California, is one of the most well-attended powwows on the West Coast
The United Tribes International Powwow takes place in Bismarck, North Dakota during the first weekend of September and is one of the premier powwows in the United States
assistant|powwow_traditional_games: Traditional games played at powwows include the Stick Game, Hand Games, Drum and Dance Competitions, Indian Relay, Lacrosse, Double Ball, and Hoop Dance
assistant|powwow_highlight: Drum and dance competitions attract the largest crowds and are considered the highlight of a powwow
assistant|powwow_attendance_tips: Tips for attending a powwow: dress appropriately, wear comfortable shoes, bring a chair or blanket, bring sunscreen and a hat, be respectful, bring cash, and bring water
